🎓 Your Professor Doesn't Want 'Original Ideas' — Here's What They Actually Mark

Stop trying to invent a new theory in your undergrad essay. Here is what 'critical thinking' actually means to a grader.

❌ The Common 54% Trap:
Trying to invent an entirely novel theoretical model from scratch, but only ending up with an unsubstantiated opinion piece.

✅ The First-Class Blueprint (78%+):
Contrasting opposing empirical studies, critiquing their sampling limitations, and synthesizing a justified academic position.

📋 Pre-Submission Rubric Checklist:
✔ Every argument is substantiated by peer-reviewed evidence.
✔ Alternative scholarly perspectives are rigorously evaluated.
✔ Conclusion directly answers the assignment marking rubric.
